set.audit_note: Tier 4 spot check November 8, 2026: Integrated Plan (pp. 126-127) confirms one capital project via RFP, minimum 2 units, $450,000 BHSA per unit, available by June 30, 2027, by-right required in RFP; BHBH beds move to BHSA July 1, 2027. Budget template page confirms Housing Interventions $6,930,885 / $6,792,267 / $6,656,422 at 30% and $900,000 capital in Year 1. Bed counts (107 PSH, 86 board and care) not located in these documents; plan states 205 permanent and 10 interim rental subsidy slots per year. prevailing_wage_trigger true has no cited rule in prevailing_wage_basis.

reason: Plan and budget template match on award size, per unit cap, capital timing and eligibility.

set.affordability_requirement: Extremely low to moderate income (most loans at or below 80% AMI); can finance units to 120% or 160% AMI; priority for housing serving people with disabilities; 40% of HTF resources committed to households with special needs. LHTF Loans: 55-year affordability, LIHTC-like income targeting, and 30% of LHTF funds must serve ELI units.
set.prevailing_wage_basis: HTF LHTF Program Guidelines, Underwriting Standards item k: LHTF Loans must comply with state prevailing wage laws, but an LHTF loan will not trigger prevailing wages for projects that are otherwise exempt (https://www.slochtf.org/_files/ugd/580dcd_12941d48fbde4791a3605aa439068749.pdf). No stated rule for short-term loans from private HTF funds; outcome depends on the loan product and Labor Code 1720(c) exemptions.
set.typical_award_size: Notice of Funding Available updated April 1, 2026: up to $3 million available, maximum loan $3 million per project, term generally up to 5 years, 5% to 7% fixed interest, 0.5% to 2% fees plus costs, real estate collateral (may be subordinate), loan-to-value 80% to 100% including senior debt. LIHTC Project Loans (soft, 15-year or longer, from LHTF and PLHA grant funds): up to $40,000 per extremely low income unit and $20,000 per low income unit, $1.5 million per project. Since 2003: 70 loans over $44 million for 1,700 units; $5.9 million closed in 2024 with $20 million outstanding.
set.audit_note: Tier 4 spot check November 8, 2026: prior record said 40% of resources committed to ELI households; Underwriting Guidelines say 40% to households with special needs. Prior prevailing_wage_trigger false contradicted by LHTF guidelines for LHTF and LIHTC Project Loans. NOFA (4/1/2026) fees are 0.5% to 2%. Loan limits (4/1/2025) confirmed.

reason: Material: affordability_requirement (40% set-aside is for special needs, not ELI) and prevailing_wage_trigger (LHTF guidelines require state prevailing wage on LHTF Loans).
